sn47.6:1.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave sakuṇagghī lāpaṃ sakuṇaṃ sahasā ajjhappattā aggahesi.
sn47.6:1.2: atha kho bhikkhave lāpo sakuṇo sakuṇagghiyā hariyamāno evaṃ paridevesi
sn47.6:1.3: mayamevamha alakkhikā mayaṃ appapuññā ye mayaṃ agocare carimha paravisaye.
sn47.6:1.4: sacajja mayaṃ gocare careyyāma sake pettike visaye na myāyaṃ sakuṇagghī alaṃ abhavissa yadidaṃ yuddhāyāti.
sn47.6:1.5: ko pana te lāpa gocaro sako pettiko visayoti.
sn47.6:1.7: atha kho bhikkhave sakuṇagghī sake bale apatthaddhā sake bale avādamānā lāpaṃ sakuṇaṃ pamuñci
sn47.6:1.8: gaccha kho tvaṃ lāpa tatrapi me gantvā na mokkhasīti.
sn47.6:2.1: atha kho bhikkhave lāpo sakuṇo naṅgalakaṭṭhakaraṇaṃ leḍḍuṭṭhānaṃ gantvā mahantaṃ leḍḍuṃ abhirūhitvā sakuṇagghiṃ vadamāno aṭṭhāsi
sn47.6:2.2: ehi khodāni me sakuṇagghi ehi khodāni me sakuṇagghīti.
sn47.6:2.3: atha kho sā bhikkhave sakuṇagghī sake bale apatthaddhā sake bale avādamānā ubho pakkhe sandhāya lāpaṃ sakuṇaṃ sahasā ajjhappattā.
sn47.6:2.4: yadā kho bhikkhave aññāsi lāpo sakuṇo bahu āgatā kho myāyaṃ sakuṇagghīti athasseva leḍḍussa antaraṃ paccupādi.
sn47.6:2.5: atha kho bhikkhave sakuṇagghī tattheva uraṃ paccatāḷesi.
sn47.6:2.6: evañhetaṃ bhikkhave hoti yo agocare carati paravisaye.
sn47.6:3.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave mā agocare carittha paravisaye.
sn47.6:3.2: agocare bhikkhave carataṃ paravisaye lacchati māro otāraṃ lacchati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
sn47.6:3.3: ko ca bhikkhave bhikkhuno agocaro paravisayo.
sn47.6:3.6: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā
sn47.6:3.10: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā.
sn47.6:4.1: gocare bhikkhave caratha sake pettike visaye.
sn47.6:4.2: gocare bhikkhave carataṃ sake pettike visaye na lacchati māro otāraṃ na lacchati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
sn47.6:4.3: ko ca bhikkhave bhikkhuno gocaro sako pettiko visayo.
sn47.6:4.7: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.6:4.10: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.6:4.11: ayaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno gocaro sako pettiko visayoti.
